title: Data Security Finding event (DLP detection telemetry for exfiltration triage, scoping and containment verification)
summary: OCSF Data Security Finding events the data_exfil playbook consumes at three steps: the originating DLP / data-classification detection at triage-signal, related findings for the same actor and resource set at scope-assessment, and the absence of further findings as the containment-verification signal. This is the OCSF class DLP and data-classification tooling emits (uid 2006, added to the Findings category in OCSF 1.2); the catalogue previously referenced a speculative `dlp_alert` class that does not exist upstream — provenance for that correction is on issue #875.
sources: OCSF v1.4.0 Findings category — Data Security Finding class (uid 2006)
